changelog: Company desk system: company NPCs open a dialog with scripted camera and typing effect, handling duty toggle + company management. Boss management MDT panel: funds, commission, hire/fire (incl. offline staff), grades, employee stats. Garage shop panel: vehicle cards with images, rank locks, optional rental fee (Config.Garage.RentalFee: false/number/true + per-vehicle price, cash/bank). Custom vehicle images via interface/vehicleimage/<model>.webp. nc-vehiclekeys support (other key systems still work as fallback). Existing company data fully preserved.
